title: Archbishopric
summary: ARCHBISH'OPRIC, noun [Archbishop and ric, or rick, territory or jurisdiction.] The jurisdiction or place of an archbishop; the province over which an archbishop exercises authority.

inlines.v: ARCHBISH'OPRIC, noun [Archbishop and ric, or rick, territory or jurisdiction.] The jurisdiction or place of an archbishop; the province over which an archbishop exercises authority.
